reason: The README describes dsh-web primarily as an aggregate ecosystem that adds configurable Web GUI sidebars, panels, dashboards, skins, and related interface extensions, while also bundling automation, remote access, terminal, Git, and agent features.

summaries.zh: dsh-web 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的插件聚合包，提供可插拔的任务看板、远程控制、SSH 面板、Git 可视化、图像理解和主题皮肤等界面扩展。
summaries.en: dsh-web is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin bundle that provides pluggable interface extensions including a task board, remote control, SSH panel, Git visualization, image understanding, and themes.

capabilities: Aggregates and exposes multiple DSH Web GUI plugins
Provides task board execution and cron scheduling
Provides mobile and PC remote GUI access through pairing
Provides SSH terminal, SFTP transfer, port forwarding, and cluster command execution
Provides image analysis through configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints
Provides Git history visualization and worktree management
Provides plugin, skill, skin, and pet management features
Provides local diagnostic, repair, rollback, and profile migration functions
